title: [Gemma4] Audio (and vision) processing broken with 4‑bit quantization due to unsafe dtype cast in multimodal embedders
author: dukei

comments.author: praful-srinivasan-027
comments.body:
I've opened a PR that addresses this issue.

I was able to reproduce the reported dtype mismatch with the provided reproduction script. The root cause is that `Linear4bit.weight.dtype` reflects the packed storage dtype (`torch.uint8`) rather than the computation dtype. The fix uses `compute_dtype` when available, with a fallback to `weight.dtype` for regular `nn.Linear` layers.

The same change is applied to both the shared multimodal embedder and the vision patch embedder. I also verified that the provided reproduction no longer raises the reported dtype mismatch after the change.

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body: Thanks, replied in linked PR. This is an issue with audio branch, we need to follow the same dtype-cast as in vision block
